standard_prerequisites: Chapter Lemma lemma-base-change-on-invariant (navigation stub, not delivered): for a pre-relation j on U with an R-invariant morphism to X, the base change along any X-prime to X gives U-prime equal to the fibre product of X-prime with U over X, R-prime equal to the fibre product with R, and an induced pre-relation j-prime over B

Groupoids in Spaces, Section spaces-groupoids-section-quotient-sheaves: the quotient sheaf U/R is defined as the coequalizer of the two maps from R to U in the category of sheaves of sets on the fppf site
Coequalizers in a comma category: a coequalizer diagram in the category of sheaves over the big site remains a coequalizer diagram after restricting to the comma category of sheaves over X
Exactness of pullback in a topos: for any morphism of topoi the base change functor on sheaves preserves finite colimits, in particular coequalizers
core_obligations: Since U to X is R-invariant, the two maps from R to U composed with U to X agree, so the structural map U to X factors through the quotient sheaf U/R by the universal property of the coequalizer
The defining coequalizer diagram of U/R in sheaves of sets on the fppf site is in particular a coequalizer diagram in the comma category of sheaves over X
The base change functor X-prime times over X minus from sheaves over X to sheaves over X-prime is exact, being a pullback of sheaves in any topos, and exact functors preserve coequalizers

Applying it to the coequalizer diagram yields the coequalizer of the base-changed parallel pair, which is exactly the quotient sheaf of R-prime over U-prime; hence U-prime over R-prime is isomorphic to X-prime times over X the sheaf U over R
proof_roadmap: Factor the invariant morphism through the quotient sheaf by the coequalizer universal property
Recognize the quotient diagram as a coequalizer in the comma category over X
Transport along the exact base-change functor to obtain the isomorphism of quotient sheaves
